units.function: CLI smoke tests for company-scoped Project and Goal create/list/update/delete operations using shared client schemas.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite registers Project and Goal Commander modules, isolates the CLI context file, stubs fetch and asserts selected request URLs, methods and create payload fields.
units.keyDataModels: Company/Project/Goal opaque IDs, Project name/status/goalIds and Goal title/level/status; authentication and company context are supplied as CLI options.
units.lifecycle: Create a Project linked to Goal IDs; change Project status; list and delete Projects; create a company-level Goal, rename it, list it and delete it.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It demonstrates client/server schema reuse and basic CRUD routing, but omits get/filter/pagination, hierarchy, ownership, status transitions, duplicate links, concurrency, authorization, deletion constraints, audit/evidence and error behavior.
units.designRationale: Expose foundational planning objects to scripts with the same validation contracts as the service while keeping company scope explicit on collection operations.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs company/department/project goals connected to Work, accountable owners, responsible Agents, permissions/data contracts, approvals, evidence/results and organizational outcomes.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE ONLY at this test-unit boundary. Shared schema and explicit company-scoped collections are sensible, but the tested model is generic CRUD and does not establish the Company OS responsibility graph. Keep implementation frozen until the owning server/domain/database units determine whether any validation or lifecycle pattern merits selective reuse.
units.responsibilityConflict: Project.goalIds and Goal level/status do not identify proposer, accountable human, responsible organization, executing Agent, authorized data/tools, approval policy, evidence or measured result. Deletion/update can sever responsibility history unless the server enforces immutable references and lifecycle rules not covered here.
evidence: 9c8adee48b15aa7d12becd767e461a83a306f552 feat(mcp) [split 5/8]: integrate adapters and deployment runtime (#9560)
2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 3 tests passed
securityFindings: The tests use a fixed bearer token and company/record IDs but do not verify tenant membership, per-object authorization, token audience or cross-company rejection.
PATCH and DELETE requests have no tested expected revision, idempotency, reason, dependency check or audit receipt.
Project goalIds are accepted as a flat list without tested existence, same-company scope, duplicate suppression, cycle/hierarchy semantics or authorization to link.
Goal level/status and Project status are string fixtures; invalid transitions, unknown enums and terminal/deletion semantics are untested.
The temporary context path is isolated but context-file permissions, symlinks, stale company state and credential persistence are outside coverage.
